newsitem.title: USA: Bangor Hydro seeks emergency rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Bangor Hydro seeks emergency rate hike.

text.p: Bangor Hydro Electric Co said on Wednesday it requested an emergency rate hike from the Maine Public Utilities Commission that would bring in an extra $10 million per year.
Bangor said the request was prompted by the uncertain prospects of the Maine Yankee nuclear plant, in which the company has a seven percent interest.
If allowed, the rate increase would add about $5 per month to a typical residential bill, the company said.
Bangor asked the commission for a ruling by June 1.
The company serves 195,000 people in eastern and east central Maine.
